topic: Design the best-in-class remote-control experience for the Pi coding agent: a private mobile client that pairs with Pi like the Claude Code + Claude mobile app but must EXCEED it, without abandoning the loopback-relay / tailnet-only / foreground-authority / redaction security posture. Per experience axis deliver a concrete relay event schema, PWA UX pattern, security-preserving mechanism, and prior-art comparison plus what makes it demonstrably better than anything shipping: (1) live transcript richness (streaming text, extended thinking, TODO/plan lists, tool-call inputs and file-edit diffs, tool results, token/cost rendering vocabulary); (2) low-friction tool approval from phone with exact-action parameter binding; (3) actionable notification-as-pull loop via a bounded needs_input/finished/error attention class that deep-links to the approval without leaking decision content (resolve the content-free-push contradiction); (4) scoped accept-edits/session allow-list bound to the lease/CAS model without bypass; (5) browsable, renamable session list under opaque-id/redaction constraints; (6) background sessions and starting new work while away; (7) onboarding/pairing simpler than Tailscale+ticket; (8) single-host multi-session concurrency.

reducer.note: Detached CLI fan-out lineage: the executor owns reducer-owned sections directly (strategy machine sections, dashboard, findings registry) because the lineage artifact dir is nested under research/lineages/ and the shared reducer targets the flat research/ root.
